about: The Academic Pages (Jekyll) site was removed. Until then it lived under /traditional/<path>, and each <path> at the root was a stub pointing there. These are the pages of that site with a real equivalent now (taken from https://yaxin9luo.github.io/sitemap.xml on 2026-10-06): home, the Chinese home, the CVs, publications, projects and the blog. The build writes a redirect stub at /traditional/<path> and at <path> (except /, which is the site itself). The theme's sample pages (talks, teaching, sample posts, archives, guides) are not forwarded: at the root they get the 404 page, and any other /traditional/... URL, including old /traditional/files/ and /traditional/images/ links, is forwarded by 404.html.
